name: verify-gym curriculum
rule: Append-only. A family entry, once listed, never changes: its spec is pinned by sha256 in PROVENANCE.json and the battery refuses a change. A new family is appended with its source (the ledger whose decided claims it came from, and that ledger's sha256), its own exact side decider in BOTH verify_gym/exact.py and check.js, and its own held-out file appended to `heldout`. A new mix is a new stage id; an existing stage never changes. A held-out file, once listed, is never edited. The numbers that generate a family (tiers, ranges, weights) live once, in verify_gym/families.py; cap and limit are stated here too and the battery requires the two to agree.

families.constant: the real root of x^x = N, N an integer >= 2 not of the form k^k
families.decides: x > p/q iff p^p < N^q * q^p; x < p/q iff p^p > N^q * q^p; p/q >= 1 in lowest terms (a bar below 1 is REFUSED)
families.source: certs/xx-ledger.json: the x^x = y study, whose brackets tools/run-xx-ledger.py re-decides with the same reduction

families.constant: x = n^(1/k), n >= 2 not a perfect k-th power, k >= 2
families.decides: x > p/q iff p^k < n q^k; x < p/q iff p^k > n q^k; p/q > 0 (a bar at or below 0 is REFUSED)
families.stated_bracket: (m, m + 1), m the exact integer k-th root
families.source: the gym's own: the calibration family

families.constant: the one real root of an integer polynomial P (no rational root) in a stated isolating interval (l, h)
families.decides: the isolation first: P(l) P(h) < 0 and one sign variation of (1+t)^d P((l + h t)/(1 + t)) (Descartes); then, for l < a < h, x > a iff sign P(a) = sign P(l) and x < a iff sign P(a) = sign P(h), P(a) != 0; a <= l or a >= h by comparison
families.stated_bracket: the isolating interval: dyadic endpoints from Descartes bisection of the Cauchy bound
families.tiers: degree 3-4, coefficients in [-9, 9] (weight 4); degree 5-6, in [-20, 20] (3); cluster: (b x - a)^2 (x + c) - e, one of the two roots near a/b (3)
families.source: the gym's own: root clustering is the difficulty a float cannot see
